statement: A separately maintained yesbotics DualSense protocol document assigns the LED brightness field values 0x01 = full, 0x02 = medium and 0x03 = low, and describes the field as affecting microphone and player LEDs under a mute-flag constraint. This documents the author's compatibility interpretation, not a measured retail-device mapping. It conflicts with the 0/1/2 encoding implemented or described by nowrep/dualsensectl and XInput_HID.

applicability.revision: yesbotics/dualsense-controller-python revision 24203b8ebe0bf6bd8d123bc02174b9735f811f6a; hardware generation/firmware not measured
applicability.scope: README_PROTOCOL.md lines 310-327 documents the 1/2/3 interpretation of the common brightness field; contrasts with nowrep main.c 591-608 and XInput_HID dualsense.cpp 23-43. Documentary source only, no observed consumer actuation.
